title: Recall Remedy Reference Figures by Coverage Type — Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage
content:
# Recall Remedy Reference Figures

The Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage sets four recall figures for each coverage type: the calendar days after the owner notification date within which an owner may claim reimbursement for a remedy repair paid before the notice; the years after the first retail sale beyond which a recall remedy is not owed free of charge; whether the recall remedy is performed at no charge to the owner; and whether alternate transportation is provided while a do-not-drive recall remedy awaits parts.

| Coverage type | Owner reimbursement claim period (calendar days after notice) | Vehicle age limit (years after first retail sale) | Remedy free of charge | Alternate transportation on a do-not-drive recall awaiting parts |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty | 0 | 0 | No | No |
| Factory Complimentary Maintenance | 0 | 0 | No | No |
| Factory Basic Limited Warranty | 0 | 0 | No | No |
| Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty | 0 | 0 | No | No |
| Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty | 0 | 0 | No | No |
| Federal Emissions Performance Warranty | 0 | 0 | No | No |
| Safety Recall Remedy Coverage | 365 | 15 | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the table

- Only the Safety Recall Remedy Coverage carries recall figures: a claim period of 365 calendar days after the notification date for owner reimbursement, a vehicle age limit of 15 years after the first retail sale, a remedy free of charge, and alternate transportation on a do-not-drive recall awaiting parts.
- The other six coverage types show 0 days, 0 years and No in every column.
